services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Get your students excited about the past with a Washington State History Museum field trip! Thousands of students come to the museum every year to explore how history connects us all. A field trip to the museum helps students make connections between past and present, see real objects from the past, and explore stories from across Washington State. Please note: Field trips must be booked with at least two weeks notice. We have a maximum capacity of 150 students per day. We can schedule self-guided and History Lab field trips for groups with the following requirements: If your group has fewer than 15 students, booking a field trip is unnecessary.
